newsitem.title: GERMANY: Air France expands German routes/capacity March 30.
newsitem.headline: Air France expands German routes/capacity March 30.

text.p: Air France said it will expand its Germany network substantially from March 30 to take advantage of full European air liberalisation.
The French carrier said it wanted to expand on a 70 percent growth in passenger numbers from Germany over the last two years.
Air France will add a fifth daily flight to Paris Charles de Gaulle from Berlin Tegel, Hamburg and Stuttgart using Boeing 737-500 and Airbus A320 aircraft.
These flights connected directly to long-haul flights to South America, South Africa and other African destinations, a statement said.
Air France will start a daily Frankfurt to Nice service and add a second six days a week Frankfurt to Lyon flight with Canadair regional jets.

Code-share flights included the new Eurowings four times a day Frankfurt to Berlin Tempelhof service, and twice-daily Stuttgart-Lyon and daily Stuttgart-Nice flights with Regional Airlines. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
